---
title: "A Table a Package Writes"
shorttitle: "Package Table"
suppress-title-page: true
format:
  apaquarto-typst: default
---

<!--
Measured, not read: in typst a cell that wraps in a table a package writes
is single spaced, as the package sets it in .docx and .html, while one in a
table pandoc writes is spaced as its rows are, double here. The raw typst
stands in for apa7::apa_flextable(line_spacing = 2), which pads each cell
8pt above and below and writes no leading. Its wrapped lines had taken the
document's table spacing, double whatever line_spacing asked.
-->

```{=typst}
#table(
  columns: (1.5in, 4in),
  stroke: none,
  table.cell(inset: (left: 3pt, right: 3pt, top: 8pt, bottom: 8pt))[#text(size: 12pt)[Packone]],
  table.cell(inset: (left: 3pt, right: 3pt, top: 8pt, bottom: 8pt))[#text(size: 12pt)[Packwrap a cell long enough that it has to run on to a second line inside its column packlater]],
)
```

| Headword | Column B                      |
|:---------|:------------------------------|
| Rowone   | Pandwrap a cell long enough that it has to run on to a second line inside its column of the table pandlater |

: Pandoc caption {#tbl-pandoc}
